## About
Precision Auto Body started in Hollywood, where it was the only auto body shop for Hollywood Sports Car and Mercedes-Benz of North America when their headquarters were there. The shop later moved to the San Fernando Valley and has been family owned and operated since its inception.
Our specialties are high-end cars, but we work on all makes and models. We use only factory parts whenever possible, and we own the factory approved equipment required to repair your car back to the manufacturer's specifications.
We were one of the first repair shops in California to use a water-based paint system. The shop runs on Sun Power solar panels and has color-correct LED lighting throughout, which gives a more natural light setting.

## Services
- Virtual Photo Estimate: Send photos of the damage to start an estimate before you come in.
- Insurance claims: We work well with all insurance companies and can help expedite your collision claim.
- Rental And Shuttle: Part of our full repair process. Call and ask how it works for your repair.
- Aluminum structural repair: We are a Mercedes-Benz Elite Aluminum Structural Repair Facility. Cars are repaired to factory specs on Celette jigs.
- Body work: Body work with factory parts whenever possible and factory approved equipment. One reviewer said the paint, body work and finish were done flawlessly.
- Paint: Water-based paint, checked under color-correct LED lighting.
- Detail: A testimonial on our site says the car came back detailed, and one reviewer said theirs was washed, polished and cleaned inside.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work well with all insurance companies and can help expedite your collision claim.

Q: Do you only repair high-end cars?
A: No. High-end cars are our specialty, but we work on all makes and models.

Q: What is a DRP shop, and why does it matter?
A: DRP shops repair cars the way the insurance company wants. We are independent of DRP programs, so we repair your car the way the manufacturer wants.

Q: Do you use factory parts?
A: We use only factory parts whenever possible.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Start a virtual photo estimate on our site, or call to schedule an estimate or drop off your car.
